mode_note: rules mode (same procedure as code; EVAL_MODE=llm runs Sonnet)
method: Each stage copies var/record.db and var/golden.db, creates a fresh work.db and runs every eval document through receive, extract (rules, or Haiku when a key is set and rules are incomplete), Pip's proposal, the gateway's evidence check and decide_route(). Recall counts a planted problem as caught only when the right flag was raised and the bill was not auto-approved. Dollars protected sums planted bad bills (excluding legit new vendors and intercompany) that were not auto-approved.
